fix_results.details: Added a null/empty guard to Parse_JSON.inputs.content using an inline expression that defaults to {} when the request body is missing.

patches_applied.reason: Defaults to an empty JSON object when the trigger body is null or empty so Parse_JSON never receives a null 'content'.

fix_results.details: Set Parse_JSON.inputs.content to @triggerBody() so the action parses the correct JSON payload.

patches_applied.reason: Ensures Parse_JSON reads the actual JSON body from the trigger instead of a potentially non-JSON value produced by prior string coercion or fallbacks, preventing the 'unexpected character at start' error.

fix_results.details: Wrapped Parse_JSON.inputs.content with a sanitizer that removes UTF-8 BOM and trims leading characters to prevent parsing failures due to unexpected starting character.

patches_applied.reason: Strips a possible UTF-8 BOM/preamble and leading whitespace so the parsed payload begins with a valid JSON delimiter.
